title: Output of Sitemap URL Extractor
description: One row per page URL in the default dataset; a run summary in the OUTPUT record. Sites that return nothing get a free status row with a reason.

results.title: Extracted URLs
results.description: One row per URL. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/blog/post-1","lastmod":"2026-09-30","changefreq":"weekly","priority":0.8,"sitemapUrl":"https://example.com/sitemap.xml","site":"https://example.com"}. Status rows: {"status":"no_results","site":"https://example.com","reason":"No sitemap found…"}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: totals (sites, sitemaps, urlsOutput, duplicates, filtered), per-site details, maxUrls, stoppedReason (e.g. "Reached maxUrls (1000)…") and zeroResultsReason.
